scenicChapters.title: Greece Meteora and Pindus Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1705 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.

scenicChapters.title: Greece Meteora and Pindus Route
scenicChapters.narrative: 1705 m come off over 55 km at around 5.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
